Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live''

Indian  Standard 
SPECIFICATION  FOR  NUT  DRIVERS 


1.  Scope  —  Covers  the  dimensions  and  other  requirements  of  nut  drivers, 

2.  Dimensions  —  Shall  be  as  given  in  Table  1, 

2.1  Tolerances  —  Tolerances  on  width  across  flats  shall  be  as  specified  for  forged  and  unmachined 
(closed)  spanners  in  13:2027-1980  'Width  across  fiats  for  spanners  and  sockets  (second 
revision  )\ 

3-  Material  —  Shall  be  suitable  carbon  steels;  alloyed  or  unalloyed  steels  which  after  heat  treat- 
ment meet  the  requirements  of  hardness  and  torque  test  laid  down  in  4  and  8.  One  of  the  suitable 
alloy  steel  is  T50Cr4V2  specified  in  13:3749-1978  'Specification  for  tool  and  die  steels  for  cold 
work  (  first  revision)'  and  carbon  steel  is  45C4  of  IS  :  1570  (  Part  2  )-1979  ^Schedules  for  wrought 
steels  Part  2  Carbon  steels  (  unalloyed  steels  )  (  first  revision  )\ 

3.1  Handle  shall  be  made  of  either  plastic  or  wood.  Wooden  handles  when  supplied  shall  conform 
to  Class  5  of  IS  :  620-1975  ^Specification  for  general  requirements  for  wooden  tool  handles  {ttiird 
revision  )\  Plastic  handles  shall  be  solid  and  manufactured  from  cellulose  acetate.  Other  suitable 
plastics  may  also  be  used  if  agreed  between  the  supplier  and  the  purchaser. 

4-  Hardness  —  Nut  drivers  shall  be  properly  heat  treated  on  their  fulllength  and  shall  possess  a 
minimum  hardness  of  355  HV  (^  Z5  HRC ), 

5.  General  Requirements 

5.1  Nut  drivers  shall  be  free  from  seams,  burrs,  cracks  or  other  manufacturing  defects  and  shall  be 
finished  smooth  all  over, 

5.2  The  handles  shall  be  provided  with  proper  serrations  so  that  handles  do  not  slip  during  usage. 
The  handles  shall  be  finished  smooth  and  shall  be  convenient  for  holding. 

5.3  The  handles  shall  be  affixed  in  such  a  way  that  it  does  not  come  out  during  use  and  also  the 
nut  driver  does  not  rotate  in  the  handle, 

6.  Finish  —  Metallic  part  of  the  nut  drivers  shall  be  protected  against  rust  by  plating  with  nickel, 
chromium  or  zinc;  or  by  any  suitable  process.  The  wooden  handles  shall  be  suitably  polished, 
lacquered  or  coated  with  varnish. 

7.  Designation  —  Nut  driver  shall  be  designated  by  its  name  along  with  L  for  long  series  and  S 
for  short  series,  nominal  width  across  flats  and  torque  series  A  or  B  depending  upon  the  material 
of  manufacture  and  number  of  this  standard. 

Example: 

Nut  driver  of  long   series  with   width  across  flats  5  mm  and  of   torque  series  B  shall  be 
designated  as; 

Nut  Driver  L5B  IS  :  12453 

8.  SamplinOi  Torque  Testing,  Preservation  and  Packing  —  Shall  be  in  accordance  with 
IS  :  6131-1980  Technical  requirements  for  hand-operated  wrenches  (  spanners  )  and  sockets  ( first 
revision)'.  The  torque  test  values  shall  conform  to  series  A  if  made  of  alloy  steel  and  series  B  if 
made  of  carbon  steels  as  specified  in  IS  :  6131-1980.  The  torque  values  for  handle  to  blade  connec- 
tion shall  be  as  given  in  8.1. 

8.1  The  torque  values  for  handle  to  blade  connection  for  nut  drivers  of  nominal  size  up  to  and 
including  7  mm  shall  be  25  Nm,  /W//7  and  for  higher  sizes,  the  torque  values  shall  be  30  Nm,  i\/lin. 


Adopted  7  July  1988 


®  July  1989,  BIS

9.  Marking  —  The  nut  drivers  shall  be  clearly  stamped  with  nominal  size  ( that  is,  width  across 
flats  )  near  the  driving  end  and  the  manufacturer's  name,  initials  or  registered  trade  mark  on  the 
handle/shank  of  the  nut  driver. 

9.1  Standard  Marking  —  Details  available  with  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards. 


EXPLANATORY    NOTE 

While  preparing  this  specification,   assistance  has  been  derived  from  the  catalogues  of  the 
leading  manufacturers  of  the  product.
